mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 64 degrees and a First Quarter moon in the sky.

The City of Verona is hiring an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction projects, with a deadline to apply on September 20. Also, the city has updated sewer and stormwater utility rates to cover necessary infrastructure maintenance and operations.
There is plenty to do today with the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run and Paddy Macs, while tomorrow you can check out the free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
On Friday, August 15, a resident called in a reckless driver which led to an arrest for an O W I, second offence, along with citations for failing to use an ignition interlock device.
Today's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently closed, but they will open at 10:00 AM today for you to grab a scoop.
